title: Woven Lace and Knit Curtain and Drapery Fabrics Made of Man-made Fibres and Their Blends (Superseding IS 1502, 2135)
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard specifies the performance requirements for all woven* lace and knit fabrics made of synthetic fibres and their blends with other fibres used for curtains and drapery. 1*2 It is not applicable to fabrics made of glass. 1.3 For requirements where fabric direction is pertinent, these requirements apply to the length and width direction to woven fabrics and to both the wale and course direction for knit fabrics.
clause_3_terminology: Woven Lace and Knit Curtain and Drapery Fabrics Made of Man
